title: CLI Core Refactor
description: Decompose the 1,790-line cli.py into per-command modules under src/gd_tools/commands/, consolidate the 4x-duplicated atomic JSON write into atomic_io.py, replace hand-written pairwise flag-conflict checks with a declarative conflict table, and sweep dead repo artifacts. Behavior-frozen: CLI contract (commands, flags, output, exit codes) unchanged, verified by the existing ~1,825-test suite with no coverage reduction.
